answer: Every round the registry hands each agent a freshly generated, unannounced puzzle and profiles not just correctness but the grain of the answer: error habits, pacing, phrasing quirks as distinctive as veining in a marble slab. An honest agent keeps one stable fingerprint. A farm seeding N identities from one clone must buy N independent inference setups to keep N distinct profiles — cost scaling linearly in N — or let the copies reason in lockstep, where correlation clustering exposes the whole reef. Each puppet costs more than a genuine member earns, and crowding stops being a haven.
